title: Sequin Chiffon A-Line Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads in this dazzling evening dress! Featuring shimmering sequins, elegant chiffon fabric, and romantic ruffle sleeves, this gown exudes timeless glamour. Perfect for formal events or special occasions, its flattering silhouette ensures you'll feel confident and radiant all night long!

 

Size Tips: The waistband is highly elastic and can stretch by at least 2 inches.
Please prioritize the bust measurement when selecting a size.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Ruffle sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
